```{r}

#Diagramma di Venn (ASV Significative)
CatVars = c("HyperglicemiaMetS", "TrygliceridesMetS", "HypertensionMets", "HDL_MetS")

Res = list()
for (var in CatVars) {
  tmp = xlsx::read.xlsx("../results/metagenomics/DEseq2/AnalisiComparativaMetagenomica.xlsx", sheetName = var, row.names=1)
  tmp = tmp[tmp$padj <= 0.054,]
  row.names(tmp)
  Res[[var]] = row.names(tmp)
}

#Sex = Res[["sex"]]
HyperglicemiaMetS = Res[["HyperglicemiaMetS"]]
TrygliceridesMetS = Res[["TrygliceridesMetS"]]
HypertensionMets = Res[["HypertensionMets"]]
HDL_MetS = Res[["HDL_MetS"]]
```

```{r}
# Carica la libreria ggVennDiagram
# Crea una lista con i tuoi insiemi
venn_data <- list(
  "HyperglicemiaMetS" = HyperglicemiaMetS,
```

```{r include=FALSE}
venn_data <- list(
  "Hyperglicemia" = HyperglicemiaMetS,
  "Hypertriglyceridemia" = TrygliceridesMetS,
  "Hypertension" = HypertensionMets,
  "Low-HDL" = HDL_MetS
)


# Convertire la lista in un dataframe binario
binary_matrix <- fromList(venn_data)
binary_df <- as.data.frame(binary_matrix)

set_colors <- c(
  "Hyperglicemia" = "#E63946",  # Rosso brillante
  "Hypertriglyceridemia" = "#457B9D",         # Blu profondo
  "Hypertension" = "#F4A261", # Arancione caldo
  "Low-HDL" = "#2A9D8F"     # Verde acqu
)

fancy_upset <- ComplexUpset::upset(
    binary_df,
    colnames(binary_df),
    name=' ',
    width_ratio=0.3,  # Aumentato per ingrandire le barre laterali
    matrix=(
        intersection_matrix(geom=geom_point(shape='circle filled', size=4))  # Punti più grandi
        + scale_color_manual(
            values=set_colors,  # Usa la variabile set_colors per associare i colori
            guide=guide_legend(override.aes=list(shape='circle'))
        )
    ),
    queries=list(
        upset_query(set='Hyperglicemia', fill=set_colors['Hyperglicemia']),
        upset_query(set='Hypertriglyceridemia', fill=set_colors['Hypertriglyceridemia']),
        upset_query(set='Hypertension', fill=set_colors['Hypertension']),
        upset_query(set='Low-HDL', fill=set_colors['Low-HDL'])
        )
) + 
  theme_minimal() +  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),  # ❌ Rimuove i numeri in basso delle intersezioni
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),  # ❌ Rimuove la scritta "group"
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", linetype = "dashed")
  )
# Stampare il plot
svg("../results/metagenomics/intersections/upsetplot.svg", width = 8, height = 6)
print(fancy_upset)
dev.off()


ggsave(
  "upsetplot.png",
  plot = fancy_upset,
  width = 28,   # cm
  height = 14,    # cm (adatta in base ai tuoi pannelli)
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 600
)
```

```{r}
df2 <- data.frame(gene=unique(unlist(venn_data)))
df1 <- lapply(venn_data,function(x){
  data.frame(gene = x)
}) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "path")
```

```{r}
df_int <- lapply(df2$gene,function(x){
  # pull the name of the intersections
  intersection <- df1 %>% 
    dplyr::filter(gene==x) %>% 
    arrange(path) %>% 
    pull("path") %>% 
    paste0(collapse = "|")
  
  # build the dataframe
  data.frame(gene = x,int = intersection)
}) %>% 
  bind_rows()

df_intsort = df_int %>% 
  group_by(int) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(n=n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))

nms = c()
colss  =list()
for (inter in (df_intsort$int)){
  
  colss[[inter]] = df_int[df_int$int == inter,]$gene
}
```

```{r}
nms = c()
colss = list()

for (inter in df_intsort$int) {
  nms = append(nms, inter)
  colss[[inter]] = df_int[df_int$int == inter,]$gene
}

df_final  = plyr::ldply(colss, rbind)
names = (df_final[,1])
dff = df_final[,2:ncol(df_final)]
```

```{r}
  dt.loc[:,x] = txx
")
```

```{python}

  tmp1 = tmp[x]
  tmp1= (tmp1.loc[~pd.isnull(tmp1)])
  for y in tmp1:
    intsAsv.append(y)
    intName.append(x.replace('.', '-'))
```

```{python}

desRes = r.desRes
dfResfc = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=intsAsv, columns=desRes.keys())
dfRespvals = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=intsAsv, columns=r.variables)

adjIndex =desRes['MetS'].loc[intsAsv,:]
adjIndex.index=     adjIndex . index + '_' +adjIndex.Family + '/'         + adjIndex.Genus 
adjIndex= adjIndex.index
for ky in desRes.keys():
  for asv in intsAsv:
    tmp = desRes[ky]
    dfResfc.loc[asv, ky] = tmp.loc[asv, 'log2FoldChange']
    dfRespvals.loc[asv, ky] = tmp.loc[asv, 'padj']
    

dfResfc.index = adjIndex
dfRespvals.index = adjIndex  

dfResfc = dfResfc.sort_values(by='MetS')
dfRespvals = dfRespvals.loc[dfResfc.index]


Family = [ x.split("_")[1].split("/")[0] for x in dfResfc.index]

asvName = [ x.split("_")[0] for x in dfResfc.index]
Genus = [ x.split("/")[1] for x in dfResfc.index]
nwName = []
for asv,name in zip(asvName, Genus):
  nwName.append( asv + "_" + name)
  


[x.split("_")[1].split("/")[1] for x in dfResfc.index]
```



```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(grid)


logFC_df <- t(py$dfResfc)
row.names(logFC_df) = c("Hyperglicemia", "Hypertriglyceridemia", "Hypertension", "Low-HDL", "MetS")
pvalue_df <-t(py$dfRespvals)
row.names(pvalue_df) = c("Hyperglicemia", "Hypertriglyceridemia", "Hypertension", "Low-HDL", "MetS")
family = py$Family
nwName = py$nwName

colnames(logFC_df) = nwName
colnames(pvalue_df) = nwName
# Creare una matrice di annotazione con asterischi se p-value < 0.05
annotation_matrix <- ifelse(pvalue_df < 0.054, "*", "")

# Funzione per aggiungere asterischi alle celle della heatmap
heatmap_text <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
  grid.text(annotation_matrix[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, col = "black"))
}

## --- Prepara il vettore delle famiglie allineato alle colonne ---
# Se 'family' ha i nomi uguali a 'nwName', riordino; altrimenti lo prendo così com'è
if (!is.null(names(family))) {
  families <- as.character(family[nwName])
} else {
  families <- as.character(family)
}

# Gestione eventuali NA (facoltativo ma utile)
families[is.na(families) | families == ""] <- "NA"

# Mappa colori per Family
u <- unique(families)
base_pal <- brewer.pal(max(3, min(9, length(u))), "Set1")
pal <- colorRampPalette(base_pal)(length(u))
family_cols_map <- setNames(pal, u)

# Colore dei nomi colonna
name_colors <- family_cols_map[families]

## --- Annotazione in alto con legenda orizzontale (la barra rimane sopra) ---
top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  ` ` = factor(families, levels = u),    # ⬅️ nome vuoto
  col = list(` ` = family_cols_map),
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    title = NULL,
    direction = "horizontal",
    nrow = 3,
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  )
)

## --- Heatmap con nomi colonna colorati ---
htmp <- Heatmap(
  as.matrix(logFC_df),
  name = "logFC",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("red", "white", "blue")),
  cell_fun = heatmap_text,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1.5),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),
  column_names_rot = 60,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, col = name_colors),
  row_names_side = "left",
  top_annotation = top_anno,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "logFC",
    direction = "horizontal",
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold")
  )
)

## --- Disegno con legende in basso, fuse e centrate ---
grid.newpage()
draw(
  htmp,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)


png("../results/metagenomics/intersections/Heatmap ASV UpsetPlot.png", units = "cm",width = 30, height = 12, res =600 )
grid.newpage()
draw(
  htmp,
  heatmap_legend_side = "bottom",
  annotation_legend_side = "bottom",
  merge_legends = TRUE
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
PicrexpPath = paste0( "../results/metagenomics/ExportPicrust2/")

tax<-as.data.frame(tax)
tax_cols <- colnames(tax)
```
